title: Reminder: if you're too busy to read us, the GameDiscoverCo Show is for you!
author: Simon Carless
excerpt: We're putting this front and center, in case you missed it...
text:

Already have an account? Sign in
Reminder: if you're too busy to read us, the GameDiscoverCo Show is for you!
We're putting this front and center, in case you missed it...
Simon Carless
Aug 06, 2026
[The GameDiscoverCo game discovery newsletter is written by ‘how people find your game’ expert & company founder Simon Carless, and is a regular look at how people discover and buy video games in the 2020s.]
This is a rare ‘non-Tuesday or Friday’ newsletter from GameDiscoverCo, with one simple goal. We sometimes hear from people who say: “ I ain’t reading all that. I’m happy for u tho. Or sorry that happened ” re: our newsletters. (Yes, we know they’re long - but there’s a lot going on…)
Anyhow, it occurred to us that some of those people - GDCo subscribers who don’t have full bandwidth for our newsletter - might not know that we have a new weekly pod/vodcast, The GameDiscoverCo Show . And we’re 5 episodes in now, so it’s a great time to get on board:
Briefly: every ~40 minute long episode has myself (Simon) and Polygon co-founder & Post Games’ Chris Plante talking about game discovery goodness. We keep things snappy and structured: discussing three platform/discovery news stories, one ‘main’ story, this week/next week’s big releases, and a special surprise question.
We actually delve further into news story analysis than the newsletter does. So there’s new analysis here for regular GDCo readers. But it’s also a good way to get a pulse of what’s going on from GDCo if, say, you have ‘commute to work’ or ‘work out’ audio/video time, but no more reading time. (Curse you, time-consuming words…)
So yep, you can sub to the podcast via Apple Podcasts , Spotify & elsewhere (audio, RSS ), with a video version weekly on YouTube (below):
We’ll keep running weekly links to the latest GDCo Show episode at the bottom of our regular Tuesday newsletter, also. But this is your one-time reminder that The GameDiscoverCo Show does, and will exist.. please use it as you see fit.
[ We’re GameDiscoverCo , an analysis firm based around one simple issue: how do players find, buy and enjoy your PC or console game? We run the newsletter you’re reading, and provide real-time data services for publishers, funds, and other smart game industry folks.]
